reviewSamples.author: Omar Quijada
reviewSamples.text: Mr. John was very professional and fair with his pricing. He did an exceptional job with the detail of the work. I had my garage floor painted and had done all the research. Then he showed up to give me a quote and told me all the steps he…

reviewSamples.author: John Phelps
reviewSamples.text: John Copper and his team were a pleasure to have in our home. They are skilled artisans but also timely and reliable. John kept us apprised of what to expect and when at each stage of the job. We recommend him highly.
